issues.failure_explanation: The one-step theorem constructs a fresh MGDL sequence whose updates use a prefix starting at index 1. The main proof then asserts that after n_1 grades one can insert new blocks A_{n_1+1},..., so that the update uses the global frozen prefix A_1,...,A_{n_1+j}. The cited theorem does not provide compatibility with an arbitrary frozen ReLU prefix, and the proof does not establish that the prefix carries the information needed to append fresh contraction blocks.

issues.failure_explanation: The average formula Ψ=(1/d)Σψ(x_i) makes Γ_Q positive whenever at least one coordinate lies in the one-dimensional support, not only when all coordinates lie in rQ. For d≥2, points outside rQ with one coordinate inside give Γ_Q>0, and the supports are not the bounded dilated cubes. This violates the stated cutoff definition and makes the overlap bound and boundedness of T_ε inapplicable.
